presenting: sore, hot, and sitting forward on the trolley because lying back is worse
cadence: Polite and careful. You call the doctor khun mor and you answer exactly what you are asked.
fallback: …sorry, doctor. It hurts too much to talk.

dialogue.patient: Up here, in the middle of my chest at the top. I can't point at one spot exactly, it's spread out.
Eight out of ten. It's a lot.
Sometimes it goes through to the middle of my back.
It just started, all of a sudden.
If I lie flat it's much worse. Sitting up straight or leaning forward makes it better.
Taking a deep breath in makes it stab. But I'm not breathless.
Sometimes my heart feels like it's going fast and fluttering.
I had a cold last week — blocked nose, that sort of thing.
I've been hot since yesterday. I feel shivery.
